assessment: It is well established cellulose synthesis in higher plants requires three different but related cellulose synthase (CESA) isoforms. Here the authors provide convincing biochemical and cryo electron microscopy structural information on the interactions within soybean primary cell wall CESA homotrimers. They present an important model in which multi-subunit cellulose synthase complexes are made of homotrimers of different CESA isoforms.
